## Brand & Style
The design system targets enterprise innovators, high-growth technology ventures, and discerning digital product leaders. It balances deep-space technical precision with ethereal luminous energy. The emotional response evokes confidence, state-of-the-art craftsmanship, and surgical clarity.

The visual style merges **Technical Minimalism** with **Prismatic Glassmorphism**:
- Deep obsidian and slate foundations punctuated by structural hairline grids.
- Localized ambient illumination and iridescent aura gradients (indigo shifting into electric cyan).
- Crisp, clinical foreground elements offset by crystalline blur surfaces and focused light leaks along structural borders.

## Colors
The palette is engineered for pure dark-mode immersion, deploying deep layered slates against ultra-saturated, high-luminance accents.

- **Foundational Surfaces**:
  - `Base Floor`: `#0B0F17` (Deep Obsidian Void)
  - `Surface Tier 1`: `#0F172A` (Dark Slate Core)
  - `Surface Tier 2`: `#1E293B` (Translucent Slate Glass)
- **Primary & Functional Accents**:
  - `Primary / Electric Cyan`: `#06B6D4` (Action drivers, interactive focus, terminal precision)
  - `Secondary / Neon Indigo`: `#6366F1` (Structural anchors, active states, key depth cues)
  - `Tertiary / Vivid Purple`: `#A855F7` (Atmospheric bridges, ambient glows)
- **Typography & Neutrals**:
  - `Text Primary`: `#F8FAFC` (High-contrast pure frost white)
  - `Text Muted`: `#94A3B8` (Cool titanium grey, 60:1 base legibility)
  - `Border Idle`: `rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.12)`
  - `Border Highlight`: `linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.45) 0%, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.15) 50%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) 100%)`

## Typography
Typography creates stark hierarchy through purposeful contrast:
- **Headings (Plus Jakarta Sans)**: Tight letter tracking, solid geometry, and crisp `#F8FAFC` execution provide high visual velocity without visual fatigue.
- **Body & Technical Copy (Inter)**: Exceptional neutral legibility at scale. Muted `#94A3B8` ensures long-form reading comfort while preserving foreground-to-background contrast metrics.
- Headlines above 32px automatically step down to dedicated mobile scales on compact viewports to avoid awkward line wrapping.

## Layout & Spacing
The layout relies on a 12-column dynamic fluid grid set within a maximum constraint of `1440px`.

- **Breakpoints**:
  - `Desktop`: `>= 1024px` | 12 columns | 24px gutters | 48px outer canvas margin.
  - `Tablet`: `640px - 1023px` | 8 columns | 16px gutters | 32px outer canvas margin.
  - `Mobile`: `< 640px` | 4 columns | 16px gutters | 20px outer canvas margin.
- **Ambient Floor Grid**:
  - The viewport utilizes an underlying technical grid pattern generated via CSS: `linear-gradient(to right, rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px)` and `linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px)`, patterned at `48px x 48px`.

## Elevation & Depth
Elevation is rendered strictly via frosted glass refraction, inner containment strokes, and atmospheric aura glow instead of murky black drop shadows.

- **Level 0 (Floor Canvas)**: Solid `#0B0F17` overlaid with the technical hairline grid.
- **Level 1 (Sub-panels & Embedded Sections)**: `#0F172A` with an ambient edge border: `1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.08)`.
- **Level 2 (Glassmorphism Cards & Floating Containers)**:
  - Background: `rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.65)`.
  - Backdrop Filter: `blur(16px) saturate(180%)`.
  - Surface Border: `1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`.
  - Top/Left Gradient Accent: A subtle pseudo-element linear stroke highlighting the top-left coordinate from `#06B6D4` (35% opacity) down to `#6366F1` (10% opacity).
- **Level 3 (Modals, Flyouts & Menus)**:
  - Background: `rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.85)` with `blur(24px)`.
  - Shadow: `0 20px 50px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7), 0 0 30px -5px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.15)`.

## Shapes
A unified rounded aesthetic gives tactile polish to technical architecture without devolving into overly playful geometry:
- Standard interactive elements (buttons, inputs, chips) strictly adopt `0.5rem` (`8px`) radii.
- Content containers and glass cards implement `rounded-lg` (`1rem` / `16px`).
- Heavy hero containers or major modal overlays utilize `rounded-xl` (`1.5rem` / `24px`).

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary**: Gradient background transitioning horizontally `linear-gradient(135deg, #06B6D4 0%, #6366F1 100%)`, label `#F8FAFC` (`label-md`, semi-bold). Box shadow: `0 0 20px -3px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.4)`. Hover: 105% brightness filter, scaling to `0 0 28px 0px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.6)`.
- **Secondary (Glass)**: Background `rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.4)`, border `1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2)`, text `#F8FAFC`. Hover: Border shifts to `#06B6D4` with `rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.08)` fill.
- **Ghost**: Background transparent, text `#94A3B8`. Hover: text `#F8FAFC`, background `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)`.

### Cards & Panels
- Constructed from Elevation Level 2 glass specifications.
- Interactive cards feature a reactive cursor glow: a radial gradient overlay tracking cursor position with `radial-gradient(400px circle at var(--mouse-x) var(--mouse-y), rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.08), transparent 40%)`.

### Form Inputs
- Background: `rgba(11, 15, 23, 0.7)`.
- Border: `1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.16)`. Radius: `0.5rem`.
- Text: `#F8FAFC`, Placeholder: `#64748B`.
- Focus State: Border color resolves to `#06B6D4`, casting an exterior glow of `0 0 0 3px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.2)`.

### Chips & Badges
- Pill or rounded bounds (`0.5rem`).
- Monochromatic or neon-tinted base: `rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.12)` background, `1px solid rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.3)` border, `#06B6D4` text. Includes an optional pulsating status dot (`6px` circular aura).

### Checkboxes & Radios
- Box size: `18px x 18px`, border `1.5px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.3)`.
- Active/Checked: Fill `linear-gradient(135deg, #06B6D4, #6366F1)` with sharp white inner vector tick mark.

### Data Metric Displays & Key-Value Lists
- Dividers use hairline strokes `rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.08)`.

- **Level 1 (Sub-panels & Embedded Sections)**: `#0F172A` with an ambient edge border: `1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.08)`.
- **Level 2 (Glassmorphism Cards & Floating Containers)**:
  - Background: `rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.65)`.
  - Backdrop Filter: `blur(16px) saturate(180%)`.
  - Surface Border: `1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`.
  - Top/Left Gradient Accent: A subtle pseudo-element linear stroke highlighting the top-left coordinate from `#06B6D4` (35% opacity) down to `#6366F1` (10% opacity).
- **Level 3 (Modals, Flyouts & Menus)**:
  - Background: `rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.85)` with `blur(24px)`.
  - Shadow: `0 20px 50px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7), 0 0 30px -5px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.15)`.

## Shapes
A unified rounded aesthetic gives tactile polish to technical architecture without devolving into overly playful geometry:
- Standard interactive elements (buttons, inputs, chips) strictly adopt `0.5rem` (`8px`) radii.
- Content containers and glass cards implement `rounded-lg` (`1rem` / `16px`).
- Heavy hero containers or major modal overlays utilize `rounded-xl` (`1.5rem` / `24px`).

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary**: Gradient background transitioning horizontally `linear-gradient(135deg, #06B6D4 0%, #6366F1 100%)`, label `#F8FAFC` (`label-md`, semi-bold). Box shadow: `0 0 20px -3px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.4)`. Hover: 105% brightness filter, scaling to `0 0 28px 0px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.6)`.
- **Secondary (Glass)**: Background `rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.4)`, border `1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2)`, text `#F8FAFC`. Hover: Border shifts to `#06B6D4` with `rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.08)` fill.
- **Ghost**: Background transparent, text `#94A3B8`. Hover: text `#F8FAFC`, background `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)`.

### Cards & Panels
- Constructed from Elevation Level 2 glass specifications.
- Interactive cards feature a reactive cursor glow: a radial gradient overlay tracking cursor position with `radial-gradient(400px circle at var(--mouse-x) var(--mouse-y), rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.08), transparent 40%)`.

### Form Inputs
- Background: `rgba(11, 15, 23, 0.7)`.
- Border: `1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.16)`. Radius: `0.5rem`.
- Text: `#F8FAFC`, Placeholder: `#64748B`.
- Focus State: Border color resolves to `#06B6D4`, casting an exterior glow of `0 0 0 3px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.2)`.

### Chips & Badges
- Pill or rounded bounds (`0.5rem`).
- Monochromatic or neon-tinted base: `rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.12)` background, `1px solid rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.3)` border, `#06B6D4` text. Includes an optional pulsating status dot (`6px` circular aura).

### Checkboxes & Radios
- Box size: `18px x 18px`, border `1.5px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.3)`.
- Active/Checked: Fill `linear-gradient(135deg, #06B6D4, #6366F1)` with sharp white inner vector tick mark.

### Data Metric Displays & Key-Value Lists
- Dividers use hairline strokes `rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.08)`.
- Metrics emphasize high contrast: large values styled in `headline-lg` (`#F8FAFC`), paired with uppercase `label-sm` descriptors (`#94A3B8`).
